title: Jim Harbaugh, Justin Herbert respond to Quentin Lake's "seeing ghosts" critique

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jim Harbaugh, Justin Herbert respond to Quentin Lake's "seeing ghosts" critique
sources.description: As the football-following world tries to figure out the problem(s) with Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, Rams safety Quentin Lake provided a scathing critique of Herbert's most recent performance, in a 24-9 loss to the Rams.
